H6VA02222.name: Bishop Staten
H6VA02222.bio: Community activist from Suffolk, Virginia, who previously ran for Suffolk mayor and commissioner of revenue.

positions.stance: His campaign message is "Purpose Over Politics."
Wants Hampton Roads represented by a candidate from the 2nd Congressional District itself.
Says he is personally passionate about affordability, public safety and equal opportunity.
"Your life belongs to you, not the government."
Supports limited government and strong communities: "The solutions to local problems are found closest to home."
"Washington doesn't have a revenue problem—it has a spending problem."
Lists Second Amendment rights, government accountability and transparency, reducing federal spending and the national debt, and protecting constitutional rights among his priorities.
Also lists supporting working Americans and small businesses, housing and property rights, veterans and workforce development, criminal justice reform, and limiting federal overreach.

wiki:dennis-r-conlon.name: Dennis R. Conlon
wiki:dennis-r-conlon.bio: Retired analytical chemist who was a principal scientist in medical device product development.

positions.stance: Says he is taking no money from anyone or any organization because "Money corrupts politics."
Wants to redefine the office of U.S. Representative, keep a small staff, and says he would be content serving one term.
Supports single-payer, universal health care, calling health care "a human right," and says big pharma must be fought to afford it.
Says health care is too expensive mainly because of overuse of extremely expensive drugs.
Calls for fighting waste, fraud and abuse and for a balanced budget as the national debt grows.
Says secure borders are essential, especially to reduce illegal drugs entering communities, and should remain a top priority.
Says America should pursue peace whenever possible, avoid unnecessary wars and prioritize diplomacy.
Supports reducing the tax burden and red tape on small businesses and farmers.
Wants to make America affordable again, saying housing costs are too high.

H6TN03210.name: Donnie Lynn Ownby
H6TN03210.bio: Semi-retired military veteran whose work has included power line construction, X-ray and ultrasound tech work, and running a small trucking company.

positions.stance: Supports term limits of at most three terms for the House and two for the Senate.
Says truly educating children is essential, calling for skilled tradespeople, engineers and scientists, and history taught without bias.
Says "Manufacturing IS the Middle Class" and supports a nationwide employment base and reducing foreign aid.
Says the country must protect its borders and citizens and have the best military in the world.
Calls full employment of the workforce "a necessity that cannot be ignored."
Pledges to defend individual liberties and the Constitution and to represent his district rather than himself or lobbyists.
Wants to reduce spending, including foreign aid and unnecessary projects abroad, without harming Americans.
Calls the immigration system broken and wants legal immigration and citizenship to be easier so people come legally.
Says voters, not term limits, should decide when elected officials leave office.

H6TN05330.name: Lowell Reynolds
H6TN05330.bio: Music producer and audio engineer who is a third-year law student.

positions.stance: Says Congress must reclaim power it surrendered to the executive branch, defend the separation of powers and protect individual rights.
Says he is running to represent the people, not a political party or special interest.
Supports reducing unnecessary burdens, encouraging small business growth and protecting fair competition for working families.
Plans to keep as much money out of politics as possible and not be beholden to any major sponsor.

H6TN08383.name: Adam D. Austill
H6TN08383.bio: Doctoral candidate at the University of Memphis who provides ABA therapy to children with autism.

positions.stance: Proposes publicly funded elections, ending insider trading by members of Congress, and twelve-year term limits.
Calls for justice in the Epstein cases and for members of Congress to file public written justifications of each vote.
Wants third-party investigations of departmental misconduct and stricter punishment for crimes committed by authority figures.
Calls for firm restrictions on AI, including surveillance of citizens, data center locations and resources, and data collection.
Says "it is time to bring the corporations and billionaires to heel."

H4MO02116.name: Brandon Coulter Daugherty
H4MO02116.bio: Vice-chair of the St. Charles County Libertarian Party as of 2024.

positions.stance: Pledges to fight for liberty and the Constitution, "not the lobbyists and donors."
Opposes nation-building and regime change abroad and advocates bringing U.S. troops home.
Calls the national debt level "unjustifiable" and criticizes budgets that grossly overspend.
Says the military industrial complex and corrupt officials have sold out taxpayers and soldiers.
